description: Assess 1–100 companies from structured rows or CSV in one bounded batch, preserving per-row risk results and provider failures. Use when an agent needs to screen many companies efficiently instead of making separate risk-report calls. Selection: specialized; prefer for Use when an agent needs to screen many companies efficiently instead of making separate risk-report calls..

companyName.description: Company name as known to the caller (trading or legal name).

country.description: Country of registration/operation — ISO alpha-2 (e.g. GB), alpha-3 or English name. Strongly recommended to avoid same-name confusion.

domain.description: Company domain if no website URL is known, e.g. example.com.

industry.description: Industry/sector (context only; not used to score).

legalName.description: Full registered legal name, if different from companyName.

registrationNumber.description: Company registration number in its home registry (e.g. UK Companies House number).

name: company_risk_batch
